scripts.wave:verify: npm run -s check:types && npm run -s enforcement:trinity
scripts.wave:land: npm run -s quantum:autosave-matrix && npm run -s wave:verify && git commit -m "$(npm run -s quantum:commit-message)" && git push origin HEAD:main
scripts.wave:land-full: npm run -s quantum:autosave-matrix && npm run -s check:types && npm run -s docs:build && git commit -m "$(npm run -s quantum:commit-message)" && git push origin HEAD:main
